# Typstmd

> Markdown to PDF converter with two front-ends: a web app that compiles entirely in the browser (markdown → remark → Typst → Typst WASM compiler → PDF, no server, documents never leave the machine) and a CLI (markdown → Pandoc → Typst → PDF).

The web app lives at https://noelruault.github.io/typstmd/. Every document it emits is standalone Typst that compiles with the upstream compiler. Templates are built-in themes, pinned Typst Universe starters, or any .typ file dropped onto the page.

## Limits

- Tables: keep under about 7 columns. Typst shrinks every column when a table is wider than the page and the text overlaps; typstmd never shrinks or splits a table. Split a wide table into two keyed on its first column, or fold a short id into the name cell.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/noelruault/typstmd): GitHub source
- [Web pipeline](https://github.com/noelruault/typstmd/tree/main/web): browser front-end (Bun + remark + Typst WASM compiler)
- [CLI pipeline](https://github.com/noelruault/typstmd/tree/main/cmd): shell front-end (Pandoc + Typst)
